snippet.title: Monuments to Ruin | Official Reveal Trailer | Wishlist Now!
snippet.description:
Monuments to Ruin is a roguelite, trun-based, tower defense game set in a world ravaged by a suffocating fog.

Build defences, explore an all-encompassing fog and pray you can fight off the massive hordes of enemies. Engage with an expansive unlock system and survive in a world that changes with your decisions. 

Wishlist Monuments to Ruin now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3579410/Monuments_to_Ruin/
